STAGE: final ideation answer for round_20261028_221240_652.
GOAL: produce exactly 1 in-scope, distinct mechanism coupling training-only behaviour with hyperbolic geometry in RQ-VAE Semantic IDs.
READ: the scope contract (5 clauses), the experiment policy (one run, no ablation/sweep/seed repetition, Recall@10 > 0.065), and the 3 earlier rounds' probe lists (branch-geodesic-rank, fork-angle-transport, tangent parallel transport, incoming-cone, mobius-nextstep-drift, successor shell/angle/transport, GEO-SHELL-RQ, GEO_REPAIR, GYRO-TARGET-RQ, KAPPA_BRANCH, LORENTZ_CONE_RQ, SUCC-TAN-RQ, behaviour_anchored_geodesic_charts -- all INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_RUN).
OBSERVED: the earlier space is crowded on global curvature from branch counts, transport/parallel-transport of successor directions, cone/margin objectives, shell/volume allocation and target-side Mobius drift. Untouched corner: a self-consistent curvature FIELD over codebook cells that is re-estimated from the partition the quantizer is itself producing.
REASONING: chose IDEA CURVCELL-SID -- per-code fixed negative curvature kappa[l][k] = (log(1+B[l][k])/((d-1)R))^2, where B[l][k] = exp of the entropy of the successor-code distribution of cell k measured from training-session transitions only; the curvature-rescaled Poincare distance d_B(eps,c)/sqrt(kappa) is used in every level's argmin and commitment, so behaviour sets cell sizes and curvature reshapes the cells that re-calibrate behaviour (EM/self-consistent loop, 12 doubling-epoch refreshes, cumulative-mean smoothing, no tuned constants). Switches exist (behaviour-off: s=1; geometry-off: Euclidean over s; both-on: trained arm).
EVIDENCE: the full specification is in the final answer block of this task; the design satisfies clauses 1-5 (signal, curved operator + location, single coupling path, three switches with observables, equations/inputs/outputs/safeguards/cost at 1023 items per step x 256 codes x 4 levels).
OPEN: whether |A_k| vs B_k ordering actually materialises in one run, or the encoder absorbs the rescaling; no ablation arm is run per policy, so a null result leaves that question unresolved.
